recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless the work group opens a new issue to constrain ImplementationGuide.definition.parameter.code values or to make a breaking terminology rename.
issue_request: FHIR-25569 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to put a cnl-style invariant on ImplementationGuide.definition.parameter.code and rename existing implementation guide parameter codes to code-generation-friendly identifiers; the final resolution was to add the missing cnl invariant but not change existing codes because parameter.code is now Coding with an extensible binding.
initial_application: No local git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-25569 was found. The active ImplementationGuide StructureDefinition was introduced by the 2021 source rework with cnl-0 on ImplementationGuide and a cnl-0 condition on ImplementationGuide.name, and later canonical/metadata refactors preserved and normalized that invariant.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists implementationguide=ImplementationGuide, so the inspected StructureDefinition is in current build scope. Current source defines ImplementationGuide.definition.parameter.code as Coding with an extensible binding to ValueSet/guide-parameter-code, and the guide-parameter terminology retains existing hyphenated codes. FHIR-I WGM minutes record approval context for FHIR-25569, and no directly relevant conflicting Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because applying the name-oriented cnl-0 expression directly to parameter.code would be inappropriate now, and renaming the existing guide parameter codes is explicitly outside the final resolution.
